theme: An open day sitting on a full to-do list.
greeting: Back on the ground in St. Pete after Croatia, with a clear calendar for once. The quiet is a little deceptive — a stack of travel bookings for the girls' return tomorrow is overdue and closing fast.

needsAttention.title: Rental car for the girls' visit
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV is still unbooked and you've already landed — the car needs to be in hand before tomorrow's 3 PM pickup. Overdue since Sept 9.

needsAttention.title: St. Pete stay, nights 20–21
needsAttention.detail: The two-night landing gap before Tuesday's pickup is the 20th and 21st — tonight is the second of those, and the booking still shows open.

needsAttention.title: Passport packet, four kids
needsAttention.detail: The appointment is set; what's left is one printer sitting — DS-11s printed unsigned, birth-certificate copies, ID copies — plus a State Dept check or money order (~$400). Arriving short sends four applications home.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets, Sept 26–27
needsAttention.detail: Lodging and the car for the Orlando weekend are set; tickets for six are the only open item. Worth checking whether park reservations are required before buying.

flagged.title: Two LinkedIn replies waiting
flagged.detail: LinkedIn flagged two messages as awaiting your response — worth a glance given the search.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, receipts, and promos — Midcoast and St. Pete locals, NYT Cooking, Responsible Investor, and a few payment confirmations.

recipe.title: Roasted pumpkin soup
recipe.why: Early autumn is peak winter-squash season, so a roasted pumpkin soup makes the most of the first cool-weather harvest.

tasks.title: Book Maine Christmas rental — Portland SUV
Call dermatologist to book kids' appt
Plan grocery stop en route to Orlando villa

acts.line: The calendar is empty this morning — nothing pulls at you.
The afternoon stays open; the only clock running is on the overdue travel bookings.
The girls are picked up tomorrow at three — tonight is the last quiet one for a while.
